target: AArch64 QEMU virt with ramfb and VirtIO keyboard/tablet
checks: Installed the ISO onto a disposable 128 MiB VirtIO disk; the installer reported full read-back verification and the installed disk matched the source image byte-for-byte.
Cold-booted from the installed VirtIO disk with the CD detached and started the graphical desktop.
Launched unchanged StadiumGen.ZC as a GUI task; it returned within the 30-second acceptance deadline.
GRRead("/Demo/Games/Stadium/StadiumBG.GR") returned a valid device context after StadiumGen completed, proving generated output was written and readable from the installed disk.
The graphical guest command evaluated 40+2 to 42, and installer persistence returned 0x2a both before and after another cold reboot.
scope_note: StadiumGen output generation and read-back, installed-disk desktop operation, and persistent storage verified under QEMU. Live UTM and Pi hardware behavior are not implied.
